entries:
A rural town whose sea breezes give
the sense of something coming.

This town offers great views
due to its many hills.

Entry stairs built in memory of a
former home in a snowier climate.

A city established in restored
storehouses built 100 years ago.

A big city with skyscrapers
piercing the clouds.

A bustling city of entertainment,
with many theme parks.

A port town distributing many goods,
and a gateway to the Unova region.

Vegetables are grown by the runway
and transported by cargo plane.

In winter, the city is covered with
snow as far as the eye can see.

A city that respects history
and values old things.

A convenient city of rapid change,
showing no traces of the past.

Only Trainers who win at all the
Pokémon Gyms may challenge it.

A town where all honor old customs,
living as methodically as clockwork.

A summer retreat with a beach full of
people who enjoy summer vacations.

A city with a rail yard where
trains park for an overhaul.

A modern city of ongoing development
that draws people to it.

A place of nature's bounty, it
attracts people who long for nature.

A skyscraper where people from
all over the world can communicate.

A facility to study Pokémon
from faraway regions.

A plant site used as a playground
for children and Pokémon.

You can go through hollows
of fallen trees, too.

It is a popular place for tourists,
but too harsh to be a resort.

Ancient ruins with a glorious history,
buried in the sand as time went by.

A lot of collected products are
stored at a constant temperature.

A cave where electrically charged
stones float.

It has a reputation as a mine
littered with valuable ore.

The oldest tower in the Unova
region. No one knows its history.

These steep slopes are the last
obstacle before the Pokémon League!

Legend says if you approach this
big chasm, disasters surely follow.

An island symbol of hope for a world
where humans and Pokémon live free.

Team Plasma's secret lab is located
on a quiet little island.

This underwater pool grew from
rainwater soaking into the ground.

A forgotten cave sealed with
hints of a legend's presence.

A tall tower with a large bell whose
tones are said to purify the spirit.

They say water collecting in hollows
on the flat land created the moor.

People once lived in this village, and
it still feels the same as it did then.
A world-famous sea of shining waves.

A mysterious forest where people get
lost despite the simple landscape.

A small road by the shore, where you
can enjoy the seascape in peace.

A pastoral road where novice
Trainers can challenge one another.

A long and winding road with lots
of ponds and tall grass.

A sandstorm delayed the road
construction to connect two cities.

A busy road where
performers gather.

A road with many trees
for nature lovers.

Raised walkways help you
avoid the tall grass.

It rains a lot here, and the marshy
swamp holds many Pokémon.

This paved road attracts
those who love bikes.

A road leading to the Badge Check
Gates, chock full of showoffs.

Limpid streams carved beautiful
scenery on this road.

A place of fun, where it's enjoyable
just walking over its gentle hills.

This seaside route is famous for
sand bars that cross the ocean.

A road covered with mist from
the waterfalls.

A road whose sharp cliffs may scare
some people off.

Many who visit Nimbasa City
drop by to take a break.

The fast current here makes it
difficult to surf.

Some researchers believe it was once
contiguous with Desert Resort.

The biggest, longest bridge in Unova
has four supporting towers.

A drawbridge raises and lowers,
depending on the ship schedules.

A sturdy steel bridge that won't
budge an inch when trains cross it.

An old bridge that settlers of the
Unova region built and now live on.

The most advanced bridge in Unova,
designed to soften any impact.

In the middle of the Unova region,
it is a place of mysterious power.

Trainers seeking further strength
enter the cavern despite the risks.
